text: what does that mean exactly so the host ranges are the thing that basically materialize the mesh and in this regard its the door missing it?
resolution: Comprehension question on req_3048/3049, answered: host part ranges do NOT produce the mesh — the triangles are saved independently and were never missing. Ranges are the ownership table mapping authored-face spans to outliner parts (Door Frame [0,36), Door Leaf [333,398)). Losing the table merges every part into one anonymous row on reopen (reader synthesizes one all-covering range) and specifically kills the DOOR export because compiling a door requires locating the Door Leaf part's range to split swinging leaf from static frame — no ranges, no leaf, no cooked piece, hence the invisible placement (a plain wall piece would have survived rangeless). No code changed; the who-cleared-the-table hunt continues via the req_3049 tripwires.
